principles: Never label monthly/weekly source observations as fresh daily measurements.
Distinguish market signals, confirmations and composites.
Daily publication refreshes the analysis, not necessarily every underlying series.
No uncalibrated probability claims and no invented values.
Separate observed association from established causation.

indicators.label: Equal-weight minus cap-weight S&P 500
indicators.interpretation: Narrow leadership can conceal index fragility.

indicators.label: S&P 500 one-month drawdown
indicators.interpretation: Measures index decline from a recent peak.

indicators.label: NYSE advance-decline breadth
indicators.source: Market breadth vendor / licensed exchange data
indicators.interpretation: Shows participation beyond a pair of equity ETFs.

indicators.label: Stocks above 200-day average
indicators.source: Market breadth vendor / calculated constituent prices
indicators.interpretation: Share of stocks in long-term uptrends.

indicators.label: CBOE VIX
indicators.interpretation: Options-implied near-term equity volatility.

indicators.label: VIX near/long futures spread
indicators.interpretation: Backwardation can indicate immediate demand for protection.

indicators.label: S&P 500 realized volatility
indicators.interpretation: Observed recent price fluctuations; distinct from implied volatility.

indicators.label: US high-yield option-adjusted spread
indicators.interpretation: Compensation for lower-rated corporate credit risk.

indicators.label: US investment-grade OAS
indicators.interpretation: Pricing of investment-grade credit risk.

indicators.label: US BBB option-adjusted spread
indicators.interpretation: Watch the riskiest major investment-grade cohort.

indicators.label: 20-day change in HY OAS
indicators.interpretation: Credit deterioration can matter before absolute levels are extreme.

indicators.label: Credit stress composite
indicators.interpretation: Composite must expose constituent contributions and avoid double counting.

indicators.label: Regional bank ETF drawdown
indicators.interpretation: Equity-market proxy for perceived regional-bank pressure.

indicators.label: St Louis Financial Stress Index
indicators.interpretation: Broad financial stress gauge; cannot update on nonrelease days.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index
indicators.interpretation: Aggregate financing conditions across markets.

indicators.label: Commercial paper–fed funds spread
indicators.interpretation: Stress in short-term private funding markets.

indicators.label: US 10y minus 2y Treasury spread
indicators.interpretation: Shape of Treasury curve; regime matters more than a daily wiggle.

indicators.label: US 10y minus 3m Treasury spread
indicators.interpretation: Term structure input to growth and recession assessment.

indicators.label: Effective federal funds rate
indicators.interpretation: Current short-term policy rate.

indicators.label: 10-year TIPS real yield
indicators.interpretation: Changes in real yields affect long-duration asset valuations.

indicators.label: CPI annual inflation
indicators.interpretation: Rolling annual inflation; monthly release not daily measurement.

indicators.label: Core PCE annual inflation
indicators.interpretation: Underlying consumer inflation measure watched by the Fed.

indicators.label: 10-year inflation expectations proxy
indicators.interpretation: Market-implied inflation compensation; includes risk premia.

indicators.label: ISM manufacturing PMI
indicators.source: Licensed ISM publication, not assumed freely redistributable
indicators.interpretation: Manufacturing survey; source and redistribution rights to confirm.

indicators.label: US unemployment rate
indicators.interpretation: Labour-market slack, with release lag.

indicators.label: Sahm Rule real-time recession indicator
indicators.interpretation: Unemployment-based recession signal; not a daily forecast.

indicators.label: Initial unemployment claims
indicators.interpretation: Higher-frequency labour market deterioration.

indicators.label: Recession-risk composite
indicators.interpretation: A model score, not an empirical probability unless calibrated.

indicators.label: Money-market mutual fund assets
indicators.source: FRED WRMFNS / relevant release (verify before implementation)
indicators.interpretation: Cash parked in money-market funds is not itself a buy signal.

indicators.label: Federal Reserve assets
indicators.interpretation: Central bank balance-sheet size; not a stand-alone liquidity measure.

indicators.label: Broad trade-weighted US dollar
indicators.interpretation: A stronger dollar can tighten some global financial conditions.

indicators.label: Gold price
indicators.source: Selected market vendor; license/source to verify
indicators.interpretation: Safe-haven demand, real yields and FX all influence gold.

indicators.label: WTI crude oil price
indicators.interpretation: Commodity input into inflation and economic conditions.
